issues.span: Do not think about arising or no arising.
issues.evidence: Academic: 'Not conceptualizing either non-arising or arising' - the point is not holding a fixed idea, not refusing to think.
issues.fix: Do not hold on to any fixed idea about arising or no arising.

issues.span: all things are with no nature of their own
issues.evidence: Locked term 'with no nature of its own' is forced into an ungrammatical clause; academic: 'phenomena are devoid of intrinsic nature'.
issues.fix: They completely understand that all things have no nature of their own.

issues.span: rests on a base through a stay without staying
issues.evidence: Academic: 'abides in a basis by abiding without abiding'; the children's phrase is tangled and 'the true way to stay' adds 'true'.
issues.fix: In the same way, an awakening hero rests on a base by a stay without staying. The Victorious One taught that this stay without staying is how to stay.

issues.evidence: Academic: 'one sees no crossing to go from this shore to the other' - no river is mentioned.
issues.fix: It is like not seeing any way to cross from this shore to the other shore.

issues.span: When I spoke the truth of this highest perfection
issues.evidence: Academic: 'When I spoke in conformity with this supreme perfection' (Tib. mthun par smra) - speaking in accord with it, not 'the truth of' it.
issues.fix: When I spoke in line with this highest perfection

issues.evidence: Not in the text; protection is stated only for whoever respects, retains and understands it, in the next clause.
issues.fix: The Protectors practice this perfect wisdom. Anyone who respects, remembers, and truly understands it will not be hurt by poison, weapons, fire, or water.

issues.span: in the past, present and future
issues.evidence: Academic: offerings 'at the three times of each day' (three times a day); the locked term 'past, present and future' conflicts with the context. Also 'sweet incense' for 'supreme incense'.
issues.fix: They offer heavenly flowers, the best incense, and oils three times every day.

issues.span: in every realm of living beings
issues.evidence: Academic: 'the many realms of sentient beings', not every realm.
issues.fix: in the many realms of living beings

issues.span: each became a perfect doctor and an unsurpassed king of healers
issues.evidence: Academic: only 'unsurpassed kings of physicians'; 'perfect doctor' is an added second title.
issues.fix: each became an unsurpassed king of healers.
